roles.defaultModelHint: Leave empty to follow the session
roles.safetyNote: The tool allowlist and approval policy are enforced by the runtime and the native trust boundary; a persona cannot bypass them. Enabling "Run command" still requires approval for every command — it only runs straight through when the session is in Auto mode and this role's apply policy is auto. Enabling "Drive Agent" authorizes the native Coding Agent to run tools and modify the workspace or session with elevated privileges and no per-call approval.
